findings.title: Sticky Abort in SessionCoordinator Bricks Subsequent Prompts and Leaks Child Abort to Root
findings.evidence: In coordinator.ts, abort() sets this.isAborted = true unconditionally. In prompt(), if (this.isAborted) throws SessionError('SESSION_ABORTED'). The flag is never reset to false. In a living agent session, aborting generation cancels the current turn but allows subsequent user prompts/steering; the current implementation permanently bricks all future prompts. Furthermore, calling abort(childConversationId) sets this.isAborted on the root coordinator, terminating the root session.
findings.impact: Session becomes permanently unusable after aborting an in-flight prompt, and subagent abort cascades to brick root session.

findings.title: Hardcoded contentIndex in DurableEventAdapter Collapses Multi-Part Streaming Blocks
findings.evidence: In durable-event-adapter.ts lines 43, 118, 122, assistantMessageEvent emissions for thinking_delta, text_delta, and thinking_end hardcode contentIndex: 0. While watchEvents correctly extracts contentIndex: i from multi-block generations, DurableEventAdapter discards change.contentIndex. Multi-part responses (e.g. index 0 thinking, index 1 text) collide at index 0.
findings.impact: Streaming text and thinking deltas for multi-block responses overwrite or collide at contentIndex 0 on the JSON-RPC wire.

findings.title: Decorative Dependencies in SessionCoordinator (Hollow Constructor Injection)
findings.evidence: SessionCoordinatorOptions declares modelProvider?: IModelProvider, executionEnv?: IExecutionEnvironment, and resourceLoader?: IResourceLoader. SessionCoordinator constructor assigns them to private fields, but none of these three fields are ever called or referenced anywhere in the class methods.
findings.impact: Violates AP-074 and AP-076: decorative dependencies and hollow DI surface misleading callers into passing uninvoked services.

findings.title: Incomplete Assertion Integrity in Walking Skeleton Test Oracle (Second Turn Reply Unverified)
findings.evidence: Step 10 of e2e-walking-skeleton.test.ts submits prompt 'Second turn', waits for turn_complete, and asserts stateAfterSecondPrompt.entryCount >= 4. It never queries session/getTranscript to verify the assistant's second reply text is 'Echo: Second turn'. Furthermore, the test does not verify that streaming deltas arrived strictly prior to turn_complete emission.
findings.impact: Verification relies on receipt and count assertions rather than end-to-end transcript content integrity (AP-076).

findings.title: Double Disposal of Built-in Codemode Extension on Session Close
findings.evidence: assembleDurableZero.close() explicitly calls codemodeBuiltin.teardown(). However, coordinator.close() -> PiDurableEngine.close() -> runtime.close() -> activeEnvState.cleanup() -> codingRegistry.builtinRegistry.teardownAll() already invokes teardown() on all registered builtins. codemodeBuiltin is torn down twice.
findings.impact: Double invocation of teardown on the same extension instance risks double-free errors or unhandled rejections during shutdown.

findings.title: StdioJsonRpcServer Ignores Stdin EOF / Close Event (Process Hang Hazard)
findings.evidence: StdioJsonRpcServer.start() registers a listener for 'data' on stdin, but does not attach listeners for 'end' or 'close'. When the parent pipe closes without an OS signal, durable-zero serve keeps running indefinitely.
findings.impact: Subprocesses spawned by parent orchestrators or test runners hang as zombie processes when stdin closes.

findings.title: Hollow CLI Command Prototypes in Production Entrypoint ('run' and 'doctor')
findings.evidence: durable-zero run prints a string and calls process.exit(0) without executing any agent task. durable-zero doctor prints hardcoded capability strings asserting operational health without running any actual environment or storage checks.
findings.impact: Production CLI prints fake success receipts for commands that are not implemented.

findings.title: Latent Dual-Lock Contention in SessionCoordinator if ISessionStore is Supplied
findings.evidence: SessionCoordinator.start() calls this.engine.start() (which acquires SQLite session.lock via selectSession) and then if (this.store) await this.store.acquireLock(). If store is supplied, two locks are acquired on the same session directory.
findings.impact: Potential lock contention or split-brain lock ownership if store is passed; currently latent as assembleDurableZero omits store.

findings.title: Residual Split-Brain Between Runner Inline Handler and SessionDispatcher Module
findings.evidence: assembleDurableZero implements an inline switch/case for 6 methods, while Task 4B developed createSessionDispatcher with full parameter extraction and typed errors. These paths should be unified in the composition step.
findings.impact: Two distinct request dispatch implementations exist in runner until composition integration.
